question: What is the Lord's declared role in world destruction?
premises: He is engaged here to gather worlds
Even without Arjuna the warriors will not remain
inference: The Lord's power, not Arjuna's agency, destroys the opposing warriors
uncertainties: Fused sandhi forms are kept whole
plain_english: The blessed Lord said: I am Time, grown and world-destroying; I am engaged here to gather worlds. Even without you, all warriors stationed in opposing ranks will not be.
